# Legion v4

> Semantic-token React components, a shadcn copy registry, and bilingual documentation.

## Components (English)
- [Button](http://localhost:3000/docs/components/button): Token-driven action control with five variants, three sizes, and six states.
- [Button Markdown](http://localhost:3000/docs/components/button.md): Plain-text component reference with props and dependencies.
- [Button Preview](http://localhost:3000/preview/button): Live matrix of variants, sizes, and states.
- [Component metadata](http://localhost:3000/r/button.json): Generated props, dependencies, examples, and documentation routes.

## Komponen (Bahasa Indonesia)
- [Button](http://localhost:3000/id/docs/components/button): Komponen aksi berbasis token dengan lima varian, tiga ukuran, dan enam state.
- [Button Markdown](http://localhost:3000/id/docs/components/button.md): Referensi komponen teks biasa dengan props dan dependensi.
- [Pratinjau Button](http://localhost:3000/preview/button): Matriks varian, ukuran, dan state secara langsung.

## Tokens
- [Theme item](http://localhost:3000/r/theme.json): Semantic light and dark tokens with Tailwind mappings.

## Registry
- [Registry index](http://localhost:3000/r/registry.json): theme, utils, and button items.
- [Repository](https://github.com/imamathaya/legionv4): Source, specs, and accessibility checklists.
